capabilities.goal: Lists the CLI command surface as JSON.
Signs in using a token read from standard input and optionally sets the backend URL.
Shows the signed-in account and whether the backend responds.
Reports version, configuration, cache freshness, and backend health, or repairs the installation.
Lists income and expense categories, optionally filtered by type.
Creates an income or expense category, optionally marking it tax-deductible.
Lists clients.
Finds clients by text.
Creates a client using fields or a JSON object.
Updates fields on a client.
Permanently deletes a client when explicitly forced.
Lists invoices, optionally filtered by status.
Shows dashboard statistics, optionally for a specified year.
Records one income entry with its amount, description, date, and optional details.
Records one expense entry with its amount, description, date, and optional details.
Records a batch of entries from JSON or previews the batch without saving.
Finds transactions by type, classification, review state, date range, text, or limit.
Corrects a transaction's classification and can remember the correction for its sender.
Uploads a receipt image or PDF to a transaction.
Returns a signed receipt link for a transaction, optionally with an expiry duration.
Marks a transaction reviewed without changing it.
Updates selected transaction fields or previews changes without saving.
Permanently deletes a transaction when explicitly forced.
Records receipts extracted from Gmail or previews them without saving.
Reports that native Gmail sync is not available in this version.
Creates an invoice from JSON or previews the computed totals without saving.
Emails an invoice to its client.
Shows one invoice.
Marks an invoice paid or unpaid.
Saves an invoice PDF and prints its path, optionally using a specified output path.
Shows invoice totals by status, optionally for a specified year.
Lists auto-categorization rules.
Shows one auto-categorization rule.
Creates an auto-categorization rule from JSON.
Deletes an auto-categorization rule.
Enables an auto-categorization rule.
Disables an auto-categorization rule.
Previews rule changes to transactions or applies them when committed.
Sends a confirmed report to Jacky.
Shows the status of a submitted report.
Opens a support connection after the user confirms.
Shows whether a support connection is open.
Sends the current product envelope during a support connection.
Shows unread instructions from Jacky's assistant.
Marks one support instruction as read.
Reports the outcome of a requested support action.
Ends the support connection, optionally giving a reason.
